name: Timeline: a Looks row block across two shapes
description: A block on the Timeline's Looks row dresses both shapes with a one-click Look for its span, on the render core's real pixels, and is gone outside it; a block scoped to one piece dresses only that one; the mapping layers' own Edge Effects are never written. A Media Library card replaces a row block's media.

steps.label: Before the look block: both shapes black
Inside the block: the left shape wears the look
and the right shape wears it too

eval.true.label: the mapping layers' Edge Effects are untouched

steps.label: A block scoped to Right: the left shape stays black
and the right shape wears it
A library card replaced the block's media (a solid colour at its defaults), timing kept
